note: The playback-speed ladder (player/playback-rate.js): the stops, isRate, the normalizeRate snap/clamp/fallback, and nextRate's upward cycle. The ladder constants are authored. The label and storage tests are excluded (exclusions.json): the page draws the button and still writes cp_rate (plan §5.2 setRate); the engine receives a number.
